scene_en: a calm Japandi family living room in a Riyadh apartment: walls painted a warm cashew beige, a wide beige three-seat sofa with wide armrests, a walnut veneer coffee table with tapered legs, a Berber-inspired beige low-pile rug, a slatted oak TV wall with hidden storage, ivory wood-look porcelain floor planks, a rice-paper floor lamp, linen curtains, a few ceramics and a potted olive tree
